deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled — change window open (2026-03-21 17:12 UTC). Starting rollout: service/api-sim v2.3.4 -> canary 10% (region: eu-west). deploy-id: d-4250006789

alex: Kicking off canary. Monitoring SLO dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/service/api-sim/slo (watch p95, error_rate, 5xx).

priya: I'll own /v1/embeds route. Set alert window to 2m and notify if 5xx > 0.3% for 2m.

marta: seeing a small 502 burst in eu-west — traffic-weighted error rate ~0.12% over baseline for the last minute. p95 jumped to 320ms from ~120ms. :eyes:

dan: Any signal in us-east? If 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 5m we should pause/rollback immediately.

henry: Oncall here — +1. If it keeps rising I'll authorize a pause.

alex: Spawning log tail for canary pods: `kubectl logs -l svc=api-sim-canary -f --since=2m | grep ERROR`

deploy-bot: Telemetry update: eu-west error_rate=0.60% (60s), p95=380ms. Auto-policy check: pause_threshold=0.5% over 5m (policy hit if sustained).

priya: I can roll traffic down quickly to stable. Who wants to pin stable version after?

marta: Recommend pin to v2.3.3 and annotate release_notes: "reverted due to transient gateway spike causing elevated 5xx".

dan: I'll execute rollback if we decide.

alex: Runbook snippet for rollback if needed:
```sh
deployctl rollback --deploy-id d-4250006789 --to-version v2.3.3
```

deploy-bot: Rollback command received: user=dan. Initiating rollback traffic-shift. start_ts=4250006865, target_version=v2.3.3, expected_shift_duration=60s.

henry: Created ops-log entry: https://ops.redwood.internal/notes/ops-4250006789 (tags: rollback, deploy, eu-west) — owner=dan

priya: Watching metrics — error_rate decaying to 0.08% in eu-west, p95 trending down.

marta: Confirmed p95 back to ~130ms after rollback completes.

alex: Adding note to change window: rollback performed for service/api-sim due to eu-west gateway 5xx spike. Will update release-notes channel. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy closed. Final status: ROLLED_BACK -> v2.3.3. incident_ref=ops-4250006789. All active alerts cleared.

priya: Follow-ups: add a small canary tweak to retry/backoff on gateway 502s before full rollout, and include the failing request sample in the incident writeup.

dan: I'll push the rollback PR and tag infra for a short post-mortem.

henry: Thanks all — good quick coordination.
